questions.prompt: When does junto offboard end the session?

choices.why: Offboard ends the session as it returns, so it runs last.
Idle plays no part; the command itself ends the session.

questions.prompt: A write timed out. How does the seat learn whether it applied?

choices.why: A blind rerun can apply twice; resend with --op-id so it applies once.

choices.text: junto op show with the opId it returned
choices.why: op show reports the write: queued until the editing machine rules it, then applied, or refused with its error.
since lists what changed for the seat, not the fate of one write.

choices.text: It cannot; the write is lost
choices.why: Every write carries an opId that op show can look up.

questions.prompt: Which command loads a seat's briefing and the commands it may run?

choices.why: since lists only what changed since the last session.
onboard loads guidance, briefings, connected seats, reach and the commands each allows.
docs is the general reference, the same for every seat.
A preamble is a short thought bubble above the seat.
